sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-4B is a reasoning-focused fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B, distilled from responses generated by DeepSeek-V4-Pro in Max Effect mode. It follows the same training pipeline and approximately 250,000-sample mathematics and STEM mixture used for the 9B release, while targeting a substantially smaller and more accessible deployment ...
